_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. Every key is optional except base_url and sections.
name: wise-design
_comment_navigation: The dotted JSON paths where this portal keeps its route tree. The first one that resolves wins. If the crawl finds zero routes, inspect the __NEXT_DATA__ block of the entry page and add the right path here.
_comment_content: Where the page body sits inside the payload.
_comment_types: Content-type ids and the role each one plays. Rename these to match another Contentful space. Unknown types are rendered as text, never dropped.
_comment_fonts: Optional stage. Set url to null to skip it. weights matches file names, case-insensitive.
